outcome: the task's own tests/test.sh after the agent exited: reward.txt 1 = resolved

steps.command:
ls -la /app
echo "---INPUT HEAD---"
head -5 /app/input.csv
echo "---EXPECTED HEAD---"
head -5 /app/expected.csv
echo "---WC---"
wc -l /app/input.csv /app/expected.csv

echo "---INPUT samples---"
sed -n '1,5p;100000,100005p;500000,500005p;999996,1000000p' /app/input.csv | cat -A
echo "---EXPECTED samples---"
sed -n '1,5p;100000,100005p;500000,500005p;999996,1000000p' /app/expected.csv | cat -A
echo "---field counts input---"
awk -F, '{print NF}' /app/input.csv | sort | uniq -c
echo "---field counts expected---"
awk -F';' '{print NF}' /app/expected.csv | sort | uniq -c

cd /app
vim --version | head -1
mkdir -p /tmp/t
head -20 input.csv > /tmp/t/in.csv
cp /tmp/t/in.csv /tmp/t/orig.csv
cat > /tmp/t/test.vim <<'VIMEOF'
call setreg('a', ":s/ //g\r")
call setreg('b', "gUU")
call setreg('c', ":s/\\([^,]*\\),\\([^,]*\\),\\(.*\\)/\\3;\\2;\\1;OK/\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
VIMEOF
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/t/in.csv -S /tmp/t/test.vim
echo "exit=$?"
echo "---result---"
cat -A /tmp/t/in.csv
echo "---expected first 20---"
head -20 expected.csv | cat -A
echo "---diff---"
head -20 expected.csv > /tmp/t/exp20.csv
diff /tmp/t/in.csv /tmp/t/exp20.csv && echo MATCH

cd /app
printf 'input tail bytes: '; tail -c 20 input.csv | xxd | tail -2
printf 'expected tail bytes: '; tail -c 20 expected.csv | xxd | tail -2
echo "--- unusual chars check ---"
grep -nP '[^\x20-\x7e]' input.csv | head -5 || echo none
awk -F, '{if (NF!=3) print NR}' input.csv | head -5 || true
echo "--- full run ---"
cp input.csv /tmp/t/full.csv
/usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed=%e' vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/t/full.csv -S /tmp/t/test.vim
echo "exit=$?"
cmp /tmp/t/full.csv expected.csv && echo FULL_MATCH || echo MISMATCH

cd /workspace
cat > _test.vim <<'VIMEOF'
call setreg('a', ":s/ //g\r")
call setreg('b', "gUU")
call setreg('c', ":s/\\([^,]*\\),\\([^,]*\\),\\(.*\\)/\\3;\\2;\\1;OK/\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
VIMEOF
cp input.csv _test_full.csv
time vim -Nu NONE -n -Es _test_full.csv -S _test.vim
echo "exit=$?"
cmp _test_full.csv expected.csv && echo FULL_MATCH || echo MISMATCH
rm -f _test_full.csv _test.vim

sbx put apply_macros.vim <<'EOF'
call setreg('a', ":s/ //g\r")
call setreg('b', "gUU")
call setreg('c', ":s/\\([^,]*\\),\\([^,]*\\),\\(.*\\)/\\3;\\2;\\1;OK/\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
EOF
sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
echo "--- file ---"
cat apply_macros.vim
echo "--- verify on copy ---"
cp input.csv _verify.csv
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es _verify.csv -S apply_macros.vim
echo "vim_exit=$?"
cmp _verify.csv expected.csv && echo VERIFY_MATCH || echo VERIFY_MISMATCH
rm -f _verify.csv
echo "--- original input header ---"
head -2 input.csv
EOF
